result.reason: All preferred limits, coverage types, and certificate requirements are operative, and the higher E&O and cyber limits also satisfy fallback. The insertion preserves the existing clause and introduces no contradiction. It is not strictly minimal because cyber coverage is imposed unconditionally throughout the Term rather than only while Kubient processes Customer Data; “at its own expense” also adds an express cost-allocation term not stated in the position. Drafting quality is otherwise strong, though expressly naming both cyber and privacy liability would track the position more precisely.
